name: Living Cautery Convergence
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.8-block radius for 12 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 2 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 3.8 blocks with 30% health
• Puts out fire
